watches.name: V03P-BR/MR/WH

watches.name: PKG01-IRIS
watches.description: This paired down black and white watch is a limited edition produced in 300 individually numbered pieces. We call it the PKG01-IRIS. It has a custom designed white dial with geometrical graphics protected by a sapphire crystal, a limited edition engraving on the case back and a high quality, black Italian leather strap. The PKG01-IRIS is part of the limited PKG01 Asteroid collection designed by Patrick Kim-Gustafson and Hans David Ericsson.

watches.name: V02MKII - Silver Set
watches.description: The V02MKII is an unusual watch that is designed to be clever, not smart. Unlike most other watches, the V02MKII uses three compass needle hands that act in a similar way to traditional minute, hour and second hands. To tell the time, simply match the colour of the hands with the digit of the same colour on the dial. This is a gift set that includes three straps: One silver Milanese bracelet together with one black and one light brown Italian leather remborde strap. All packaged in a cardboard gift box made in Sweden.

watches.name: Archive: V03M-SI/MR
watches.description: The V03M is the first ever mechanical watch from VOID Watches. Powered by the trusted automatic 8215 movement from Japanese manufacturer Miyota this watch will run perpetually as long as you occasionally move (the watch draws it’s power from the continuous movement of your wrist). The design is inspired by the last five decades of watch design using familiar elements and color schemes. The over sized luminescent hour indexes are clearly visible in all conditions and the simple bright white hands provides the perfect contrast against the matte black dial. The discrete branding has been placed where traditionally the marking of origin is placed, immediately visible to watch aficionados. This item is new and unworn and comes in its original packaging.

watches.name: Archive: PKG01-GQ
watches.description: Looking back over the last 50 years of watch design, we've taken notes from classic design principles to create this collection, both understated in silhouette and colour palette. The 7mm case is the thinnest in our collection and is proportionally balanced by an acutely tapered crown. The watch features some of our core branding elements: a red accent on the second hand and modest logo on the face and buckle. This item is new and unworn and is a sample from a collaboration we did together with GQ for their 60th anniversary. It comes in the VOID Watches signature gift box. NOTE: This watch also come with an extra RAF striped nylon strap and a changing tool.

watches.name: Archive: V01EL-PO/BL
watches.description: The V01EL with it's delicately proportioned half glass, half stainless steel front has in short time become a design classic. The design draws heavily on the Scandinavian design tradition using simple geometries to create a unique form. The watch has a mineral glass crystal with a backlit display showing time/date and the strap is made of genuine leather. The inverted LCD-display set in its stainless steel frame in combination with the traditional leather strap creates an elegant contrast between old and new, giving a hint of the past and at the same time being very contemporary. NOTE: This is a heavily used watch with plenty of scratches (let's call it patina) so please have a close look at the images of the actual watch (the images showing a new watch is for reference only). The watch comes with a new leather band and is packaged in the signature VOID Watches gift box.

watches.name: Archive: V02-BR/MR
watches.description: The V02 is the analogue extension of the iconic V01EL watch using the same geometry with a delicately proportioned half glass, half stainless steel front, but with a classic speedometer looking dial. The V02 uses two ‘compass needle’ hands, the short hand representing the hours and the long the minutes as on any other watch. Each hand has one red and one white end where each color corresponds to the number with the matching color on the dial. Note: This is a new and unused example from our archive. No original packaging.

watches.name: Archive: SOND-Yellow
watches.description: SOND by VOID Watches is a truly unique timekeeper. Injection moulded as a single piece, the SOND has an innovative locking mechanism that uses the watch itself to secure the nylon watchband. This not only greatly reduces the number of moving parts but also creates an interesting contrast of colors and materials and makes the strap easy to change and adjust. The watchband is delivered at raw length that fits even the biggest wrists and can easily be cut down to the perfect length. The battery has a lifetime of two years and is exchanged simply by using a coin to open the stainless steel battery hatch on the back of the watch. This is a new and unworn watch.

watches.name: Archive: V03A-BL/BL/BL
watches.description: The V03A is a modern interpretation of a classic wristwatch. Based on a round case with a thin metal edge framing the dial and thin lugs securing the strap this alarm watch sits beautifully on any wrist. The design hinges on the use of high quality materials like stainless steel and premium leather with close attention being paid to detailing such as the concentric numbers following the dial edge and the discreet branding replacing the normal country of origin markings on the lower part of the dial. The arrow shaped alarm hand creates an interesting detail. This watch is from our archive. It's unworn but have a few scratches, one on the crystal and a few along the edge of the front. But, still very wearable.

specsRaw.CONDITION: Unworn but with a few scratches
specsRaw.FUNCTIONS: Alarm, note the alarm sound is not very strong

watches.name: Archive: V01LED-BR/MR
watches.description: Following the success of the V01EL and V02 series, the V01LED stays true to the original VOID design concept but employs an LED display that lights up in red at the push of a button, contrasting sharply with the stainless steel case. Protecting the LED panel is a scratch resistant mineral glass crystal, and the entire case sits comfortably on your wrist with a genuine leather strap or a metal bracelet. LED watches were first introduced in the early 70s and were at that time sold as high-end timepieces. With the V01LED we aim to recreate the feeling of those LED glory days. This example is from our archive and is in as-new condition. This is a great chance to pick up a real classic that will not come back again. An extra black leather strap is included. No original packaging. The last two images show the actual watch.

watches.name: 14mm Milanese Bracelet - Copper
watches.description: The 14mm Milanese bracelet fits our V03P collection. The technique to produce this type of weave was developed in Milan at the end of the 19th century. The smooth mesh is made from 0.6mm stainless steel thread and wraps fluidly around your wrist. It has an easy to change quick release spring bar (no tools required) and an adjustable safety buckle with a double locking mechanism.

watches.name: V03W-365
watches.description: Some days require us to slow down and reflect more than others. With this in mind, we've limited the production of the V03W-365 to 365 pieces, one watch for each day of the year. Included in the set is a custom changing tool to make the strap change a part of the product experience.

watches.name: 22mm Milanese Bracelet - Silver
watches.description: The 22mm Milanese bracelet fits our V01MKII and V02MKII collections. The technique to produce this type of weave was developed in Milan at the end of the 19th century. The smooth mesh is made from 0.6mm stainless steel thread and wraps fluidly around your wrist. It has an easy to change quick release spring bar (no tools required) and an adjustable safety buckle with a double locking mechanism.

watches.name: PKG01-BL/BL/WH
watches.description: The PKG01 (named after its designer Patrick Kim-Gustafson) is an elegant modern interpretation of the classic mens wristwatch. At 38mm in diameter and a thickness of only 7mm, the size is ‘just right’. As with all well executed minimal designs, the devil is in the details. The different surface finishes of the case and the subtle detailing take this timepiece beyond your average wristwatch .

watches.name: PKG01-AM Limited Edition
watches.description: SOLD OUT - This was a limited edition and it won't be restocked. This classic gold and brown watch is a limited edition produced in 150 individually numbered watches made for those who cherish the brighter part of the day. We call it the PKG01-AM, where AM stands for Ante Meridiem or Before Noon. It has a luminescent, custom designed cream dial, a limited edition engraving on the case back and a high quality, light brown Italian leather strap. Read more about this limited edition and its sister watch, the PKG01-PM here .
tags: Color: Gold / Cream / Brown Ltd Ed.

watches.name: PKG01-PM Limited Edition
watches.description: This version of the PKG01 is a limited edition produced in 150 individually numbered watches. We call it the PKG01-PM, where PM stands for Post Meridiem or After Noon. It comes with a limited edition engraving on the case back and a high quality, black Italian leather strap. The custom designed matte black luminescent dial with its shiny black hands provide enough contrast to be clearly visible in daylight but become diffuse once the sun sets. For the night dweller, time becomes less important. This blacked out, slightly impractical watch is made for those who cherish the darker part of the day. Read more about this limited edition and its sister watch, the PKG01-AM here .
